entities.summary: Joseph Werth SJ is a Russian-German Catholic prelate who has been the Bishop of Transfiguration in Novosibirsk since 2002. He was consecrated as a bishop in 1991 and was appointed by Pope John Paul II as apostolic administrator of Siberia.
